articles.summary: National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI) has issued the following investor update which can be found at: https://investors.nhireit.com/News/presentations-and-webcasts/default.aspx About National Health Investors, Inc. National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI), established in 1991 as a Maryland corporation, is a self-managed real estate investment trust ("REIT"). The Company owns, leases, operates and finances the development of high-quality real estate properties, focusing on senior housing communities and medical facilities. The Company operates through two reportable segments: Real Estate Investments and SHOP. The Company's investments in real estate properties include independent living facilities, assisted living facilities, entrance-fee communities, senior living campuses, skilled nursing facilities and hospitals. For more information, visit www.nhireit.com . Forward-Looking Statements This press release includes forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A

articles.summary: National Health Investors, Inc. (NYSE: NHI) announced today its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. CEO Comments "SHOP and private-pay senior housing remain central to our long-term growth strategy, and we have invested in our executive management team to strengthen operating execution and improve portfolio performance," said Eric Mendelsohn, NHI's President and CEO. "Our strengthened team has developed a focused plan to address underperformance and position the portfolio for sustainable NOI growth consistent with our underwriting standards." "We have closed more than $395 million in investments year-to-date and expect to complete significant additional investments before year-end, with ample capital available to fund our current pipeline. This activity reflects our continued confidence in private-pay senior housing and our ability to source attractive opportunities.
